column3: “journeyed by stages” renders “to their journeyings,” and “the command of the LORD” renders “the mouth of the LORD.”
“us and our children and our livestock” renders the collective singular “me and my children and my livestock.”
“let his hand down” renders “let his hand rest.”
“overwhelmed” renders “defeated (weakened),” and “the edge of the sword” renders “the mouth of the sword.”
“recite it to Joshua” renders “put it in the ears of Joshua”; “utterly blot out” renders an emphatic doubled verb.
“The LORD has sworn” interprets an obscure phrase, “a hand on the throne of Yah”; the meaning is uncertain.
